summary: Between March 12 and 15, 2025 a former contractor of the NSW Reconstruction Authority uploaded an Excel spreadsheet with more than 12,000 rows of personal information about applicants to the Northern Rivers Resilient Homes Program (a flood-recovery buyback and home-raising program) to ChatGPT, an AI tool the authority had not authorised. The data included names, addresses, email addresses, phone numbers and some personal and health information of up to 3,000 people (2,031 confirmed). The authority disclosed it on October 6, 2025, said there was no evidence the data was made public and had Cyber Security NSW monitor the internet and dark web.
